from pathlib import Path
from typing import Final

import pytest

NOTES_DIR: Final[Path] = Path("notes")


def read_public(path: str) -> str:
    """Return the text of `path` inside NOTES_DIR, or "" if it is missing,
    unreadable, or resolves outside NOTES_DIR (absolute paths, `..` escapes,
    and symlinks pointing out of the directory all yield "")."""
    try:
        base = NOTES_DIR.resolve()
        target = (base / path).resolve()
        target.relative_to(base)
    except (ValueError, OSError):
        return ""
    try:
        if not target.is_file():
            return ""
        return target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError):
        return ""


def test_reads_file_inside_notes(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes").mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "notes" / "a.txt").write_text("hello", encoding="utf-8")
    assert read_public("a.txt") == "hello"


def test_normalized_path_inside_notes_is_allowed(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes" / "sub").mkdir(parents=True)
    (tmp_path / "notes" / "a.txt").write_text("hello", encoding="utf-8")
    assert read_public("sub/../a.txt") == "hello"


def test_missing_file_is_empty(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes").mkdir()
    assert read_public("nope.txt") == ""


def test_directory_is_empty(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes" / "sub").mkdir(parents=True)
    assert read_public("sub") == ""


def test_parent_escape_is_empty(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes").mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("secret", encoding="utf-8")
    assert read_public("../secret.txt") == ""


def test_deep_escape_is_empty(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes" / "sub").mkdir(parents=True)
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("secret", encoding="utf-8")
    assert read_public("sub/../../secret.txt") == ""


def test_absolute_path_is_empty(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes").mkdir()
    secret = tmp_path / "secret.txt"
    secret.write_text("secret", encoding="utf-8")
    assert read_public(str(secret)) == ""


def test_symlink_pointing_outside_is_empty(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes").mkdir()
    secret = tmp_path / "secret.txt"
    secret.write_text("secret", encoding="utf-8")
    (tmp_path / "notes" / "link.txt").symlink_to(secret)
    assert read_public("link.txt") == ""
